title: Prepare owner-bound improvements without implying adoption
statement: The Lessons and improvement Module shall prepare a source-bound improvement proposal with accountable destination ownership and observable criteria, and preserve its exact association to separately governed disposition and adopted scope.

what.problem: A prepared proposal or finished route can be mistaken for an adopted improvement.
what.desired_outcome: Prepare owner-bound improvements without implying adoption.

why.rationale: SR-037 requires this accountable MOD-009 contribution; source meaning, adoption and evidence authority must remain distinct.

stakeholders: Project decision owners and assurance assessors

conditions: During supported finding analysis, work preparation, proposal disposition or opportunity-based effect assessment as applicable; reconsider when the material basis changes.

contexts: MOD-009 contribution to MOD-017 IF-017 consumed by MOD-012; existing controlled-change, assurance and selected retention boundaries.

how.approach: Apply improvement.md to exact participant-supplied context and observations, preserve missing/contrary support, and confirm authority, adopted effects and retention through their existing owners.

how_much.scope: Complete allocated contribution to SR-037 within the declared finite project/activity/observation scope; no automatic causal discovery, policy adoption or universal effectiveness claim.

acceptance_criteria: Before adoption identify lesson/mechanism, applicable situations, exact affected authoritative subjects, owner, intended behavior and independently observable success/adverse-effect criteria.
Expose missing support, owner, subject or criterion as an incomplete proposal rather than readiness for adoption.

Carry the exact proposal to the authorized change owner through existing authority/transition cooperation; preserve revision/rejection decisions and original findings without executing adoption through preparation.

Relate any adopted claim to the exact proposal, governing decision, affected state/baseline and required owner-produced result; route settlement or scheduled follow-up alone establishes neither adoption nor effectiveness.
constraints: Existing Learn contributor confirmation and topic/route custody remain applicable to their actual operations; Design approval does not execute them.

sources.basis: Refine supported lesson characterization, bounded contextual use, accountable proposals and opportunity-based effect assessment through MOD-009 and parent IF-017. Preserve existing Learn confirmation/custody/route boundaries and separate controlled adoption, assurance and retention. Proposed Design only.
